headline: Anthropic researcher claims AI proved Riemann Hypothesis
summary: Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge stated he believes he proved the 1859 Riemann Hypothesis with assistance from the Claude AI model.
why: The Riemann Hypothesis is a premier unsolved problem in pure mathematics regarding prime number distribution.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Demonstrations of complex reasoning showcase capabilities of Claude AI models.
